description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Argentina Argentina nationwide national holidays and published tourism non-working days for 2026 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when provincial, municipal, employer, bank, exchange, school, sector and religion-specific schedules are not generalized; regional one-off holidays are not included in this nationwide default.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Argentina: Argentina national holiday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-05-25"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/argentina-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/argentina-working-day.md
name: check_ar_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Argentina nationwide national holidays and published tourism non-working days for 2026

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Argentina.gob.ar 2026 national calendar; religious/community non-working days are retained but are not universal closures

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: Published 2026 transferred dates are included; future or Saturday/Sunday transfers are not inferred because authority selection remains explicit

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Argentina Working Day
